# Artem Polovyi

> Senior software engineer and architect in Zürich, focused on JVM platforms, system modernisation and reliable AI delivery.

Core technologies and domains: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, TypeScript, React, Angular, AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Flowable BPMN/CMMN, agentic engineering, LLM classification, OCR, and Playwright as a behaviour gate.
